title: Visual Diagram Design
description: Enable users to create and edit database diagrams through a graphic design interface. Includes creating diagrams, adding/editing tables, columns, primary keys, foreign keys, unique constraints, indexes, and manipulating canvas elements.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can create a new empty database diagram
Users can add tables to the diagram canvas
Users can add, edit, and remove table columns
Users can mark columns as primary keys
Users can create foreign key relationships between tables
Users can add unique constraints to columns
Users can add indexes to columns
Users can move, resize, and delete tables and relationships on the canvas
